shortBulletSummary: The crypto market is down 4.55%, with over $727 million in long liquidations in the last 24 hours.
Hotter-than-expected US October CPI data increases the likelihood of a December Fed rate hike, negatively impacting crypto.
US spot Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs have seen over $2 billion in outflows, while stablecoin supply shrank by $14.2 billion.
The Crypto Fear & Greed Index has dropped to 29 (fear), marking its lowest point since August.
The resignation of Nvidia's CEO led to a tumble in tech stocks, subsequently impacting Bitcoin's price.
